sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework - Supporting high quality communications infrastructure
sources.role: National planning policy for mobile and full-fibre infrastructure.
sources.facts: Policy support does not establish a mast location, network capacity, wayleave or planning approval for a specific site.
sources.guard: Coverage, checker, forecast, operator-plan and Code records do not by themselves prove service at a premise, committed build, wayleave, planning permission, capacity or security compliance.
